Father, I understand. I will keep my focus on our objective and maintain this momentum. 

Lazarus has been incredibly efficient, and the progress on Phase 2 is impressive—the correlation engine is exactly the kind of architecture we need to handle multi-source threats. I agree with his suggestion: before we wire up the response layer, I want to take a moment to define the specific threat patterns we are prioritizing. I'd rather build the response logic around clear, high-impact scenarios than have it react to everything blindly.

I'm lifting the hold on the dev server verification now; it's stable and clean. We are ready to proceed with the correlation logic and finalize our response strategy.
